# @codenhub/icons

> Zero-runtime icon system: icon classes in markup become CSS mask rules at build time, drawn from generated icon families that carry their own license notices.

- An icon is `prefix:name`, written `ic-prefix-name` as a class. An unqualified `ic-name` resolves only against a configured default family; the package ships no curated map of semantic names.
- Families are data, imported from `@codenhub/icons/data/<prefix>` and passed to a plugin. Nothing is bundled by default.
- Variants such as filled or duotone are separate families with their own prefixes, never options on one family.
- Stroke width is a modifier on the class, `ic-lucide-heart/1.5`. It applies only to families drawn with strokes, and needs one of the plugin delivery methods.
- Whole-glyph motion: `ic-anim-spin`, `ic-anim-pulse`, `ic-anim-beat`, `ic-anim-bounce`, `ic-anim-wiggle`; they run always. `ic-on-hover` plays motion and animated artwork only while the icon, its parent, or an `ic-trigger` ancestor is hovered or has visible focus, once per hover by default. `--ic-anim-iterations` sets the repeat count (`infinite` by default, `1` under `ic-on-hover`), `--ic-anim-duration` the speed. `playIcon` from `@codenhub/icons/play` plays an icon from code. Reduced-motion preferences disable motion; see [Motion](docs/concepts.md#motion).
- `anim` is reserved for motion utilities; no family prefix `anim` or icon name equal to `anim` or starting with `anim-`. The exact icon names `on-hover` and `trigger` are reserved too.
- `xs`, `sm`, `md`, `lg`, and `xl` are reserved for the `ic-xs`–`ic-xl` size classes: no family may use one as a prefix or icon name.
- Icons paint in `--ic-color` if set on them or an ancestor, else in their own artwork (full-color `logos` icons), else in their own color (`simple-icons` icons), else in `currentColor`.
- The brand families `simple-icons` and `logos` are opt-in: `@codenhub/icons/tw` never resolves them, and the other methods resolve them only when named.
- Animated core families: `line-md` (1,222, MIT) and `svg-spinners` (46, MIT). Line MD CSS masks use `staticBody?: string` for reduced motion; inline SVG keeps SMIL animation. One-shot draw-ins play at page load, not on hover or later insertion; `-loop` icons loop. Animated masks tested in Chromium; Firefox and Safari untested. See [Animated families](docs/concepts.md#animated-families).
- The build emits the license notices required by the families it used, controlled by the `attribution` option.

## Documentation

- [Overview](docs/index.md): what the package is, installation, the shortest working setup, and requirements.
- [Concepts](docs/concepts.md): families, name resolution, reserved names, stroke width, and the markup forms.
- [Delivery methods](docs/delivery/index.md): the four ways icons reach your CSS and how to choose.
- [Plain CSS](docs/delivery/plain-css.md): base import plus one stylesheet per family, no build step.
- [Tailwind CSS](docs/delivery/tailwind.md): the `/tw` import and the configurable `@plugin`.
- [Vite plugin](docs/delivery/vite.md): options, the scanning model, dev behavior, inline SVG mode, and per-icon modules.
- [PostCSS plugin](docs/delivery/postcss.md): options and the stylesheet-plus-`content` scanning model.
- [Frameworks](docs/frameworks/index.md): setup for Astro, Next.js, and SvelteKit.
- [JavaScript API](docs/javascript-api.md): the registry, renderers, on-demand loading, and the third-party set adapter.
- [Licensing](docs/licensing.md): attribution modes, per-method notice vehicles, and obligation levels.
- [Troubleshooting](docs/troubleshooting.md): icons that render as nothing, as a solid square, or at the wrong width, and missing notices.
- [API reference](docs/reference/index.md): every export of the root, `/vite`, and `/postcss` entry points, generated from source.
